items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: Interviewee mentions Ray Nance in the context of Duke Ellington ('he') going to Europe with him, and later discusses Nance's dancing style, but does not describe a direct personal or professional relationship between himself (Harry Edison) and Ray Nance.

ctx.x: Oh, well that was when he was sick.
Yeah, he went to Europe with just Ray Nance and --
